resolved_conflict.title: React Functional Immutability vs Real-Time High-Throughput Mutability
resolved_conflict.principle_a: State objects must never be mutated in place; create new object copies to maintain pure render cycles.
resolved_conflict.principle_b: Creating millions of short-lived objects per second triggers Garbage Collection (GC) pauses, causing latency spikes that drop trade orders.
resolved_conflict.resolution: PROFILE DOMAIN RESOLUTION: In Veltrix UI and general web components, Functional Immutability is strictly enforced. In MarketStrategies / Trading Execution Core, in-memory ring buffers and pre-allocated object pools use mutable in-place updates within synchronized thread-safe boundaries to achieve zero-allocation <1ms latency.
